newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch IHC Caland wins orders from Brazil, India.
newsitem.headline: Dutch IHC Caland wins orders from Brazil, India.

text.p: Dutch shipbuilding and engineering group IHC Caland NV said on Friday it had recently won a number of large orders, including contracts from Brazil and India.
The company said the contracts took new orders for the current year so far to 1.29 billion guilders ($762.4 million). Total new orders for the whole of 1995 were 1.8 billion guilders.
In the first six months of this year IHC won new orders worth 745 million guilders.

IHC said Brazilian state oil firm Petrobas placed a four-year "time-charter" order with IHC's SBM unit for a Floating Production Storage and Offloading system (FPSO), which will operate at a depth of 1,400 meters -- the deepest for any IHC FPSO.

IHC also signed a letter of intent with Dutch dredging firm Van Oord to build a 20,000 cubic meter suction hopper dredger and another letter of intent with the Dredging Corporation of India for a similar, but smaller, vessel.
